chunks: God: There is no god but He. To Him belong the attributes most beautiful.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that to God belong the most beautiful names?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia theology as a concise declaration of Tawhid, emphasizes that all perfect attributes (Asma al-Husna) are intrinsic to God's essence, distinguishing them from created beings. It serves as a bridge between the concept of divine unity and the understanding of God's self-revelation through His names, a theme central to Shia exegesis regarding the relationship between essence and attributes.
